auth.name: Name
auth.loginSubtitle: Access your household and get back to the shared inventory in one step.
auth.registerSubtitle: Create your access and leave the household ready from the first launch.
auth.loginAsideBody: Inventory, receipts and prices all belong to the same household, so what you note down shows up on every device in the house.
auth.registerAsideBody: You can create the household now or leave it for later — the app will ask when it needs one.
auth.householdHint: Optional. Fill it now to create your initial household.
auth.emailHint: The one you signed up with. We use it to identify you, not to write to you.
auth.emailHintRegister: This will be your username. It stays on your server — Stoky sends no email.
auth.passwordHintLogin: The one you chose when you created the account. It is case sensitive.
auth.passwordHintRegister: Eight characters or more. Pick something you can remember: there is no email recovery.
auth.nameHint: How you will appear to the rest of the household. A first name is enough.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts from this connection. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.authUnavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.

navigation.moreContainsCurrent: the current page is in here

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: What the house is running out of and what expires soon, at a glance.
dashboard.errorTitle: The overview could not be loaded
dashboard.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create or join one to see the inventory.
dashboard.errorGeneric: Something went wrong loading the data. Try again in a moment.
dashboard.restockEmpty: Nothing is missing: everything is above its minimum.
dashboard.restockMore: See the {count, plural, one {# remaining product} other {# remaining products}} in the inventory
dashboard.expiryEmpty: Nothing has expired and nothing is about to.
dashboard.expiryMore: There are more batches than fit here. Open them in the inventory.

edit.title: Edit product
edit.intro: Change what needs changing and save. An optional field left blank is removed from the product.
edit.nameHint: What you call it at home. For example: Whole milk.
edit.barcodeHint: The number printed under the bars. Leave it blank to remove it from the product.
edit.barcodeTakenBy: You already have “{name}” with this barcode. Change the code or leave it blank: two products in the same household cannot share one.
edit.brandHint: Who makes it. For example: Pascual.
edit.categoryHint: Used to group similar products together. For example: Dairy.
edit.unitHint: How it is usually measured. For example: kg, L or pack.
edit.minStockHint: The amount below which you want us to warn you. Leave it blank for no warning.
edit.errorTitle: The changes could not be saved
edit.errorUnitRequired: Enter the unit, for example kg or pack.
edit.errorMinStockInvalid: Minimum stock has to be a number of zero or more, or be left blank.
edit.errorBarcodeTaken: That barcode already belongs to “{name}”. Change the code or leave it blank.
edit.errorBarcodeTakenServer: That barcode already belongs to another product in the household. Change the code or leave it blank.
edit.errorGeneric: We could not save it. Check the details and try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
edit.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet.
edit.errorNotFound: This product is not in your household's catalogue. It may have been deleted, or the link may point somewhere else. Go back to the list and pick it from there.

new.title: New product
new.intro: Add a product to your household catalogue. Only the name is required; you can fill in the rest later.
new.scanContextIntro: You are creating the product for this code. It was not in your household yet, so tell us at least what it is called.
new.nameHint: What you call it at home. For example: Whole milk.
new.barcodeHint: The number printed under the bars. Leave it blank if the product has none, or you do not have it to hand.
new.barcodeTakenBy: You already have “{name}” with this barcode. Change the code or leave it blank: two products in the same household cannot share one.
new.lookupHint: We can check the public Open Food Facts catalogue. If it knows this code, we will create the product with its name, brand and category. If it does not know it, no problem: fill the form in by hand and save.
new.lookupButton: Look up in Open Food Facts
new.lookupNotFound: Open Food Facts does not know this code. Fill the form in by hand and save; the product will be created all the same.
new.lookupFailed: We could not reach Open Food Facts. You can carry on by hand and save without waiting, or try again.
new.brandHint: Who makes it. For example: Pascual.
new.categoryHint: Used to group similar products together. For example: Dairy.
new.unitHint: How it is usually measured. For example: kg, L or pack. Leave it as it is and we will store “unit”.
new.minStockHint: The amount below which you want us to warn you. Leave it blank for no warning.
new.errorTitle: The product could not be created
new.errorUnitRequired: Enter the unit, for example kg or pack.
new.errorMinStockInvalid: Minimum stock has to be a number of zero or more, or be left blank.
new.errorBarcodeTaken: That barcode already belongs to “{name}”. Change the code or leave it blank.
new.errorBarcodeTakenServer: That barcode already belongs to another product in your household: someone may have created it while you were filling this form in. Change the code or leave it blank and save again.
new.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create one, or ask to be invited, before creating products.
new.errorGeneric: We could not save it. Check the details and try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
new.successCreated: “{name}” is now in your household catalogue.
new.successCreatedFromLookup: “{name}” is now in your household catalogue, created from Open Food Facts data.

detail.errorTitle: This product could not be shown
detail.errorNotFound: This product is not in your household's catalogue. It may have been deleted, or the link may point somewhere else. Go back to the list and pick it from there.
detail.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create one, or ask to be invited, before viewing products.
detail.errorGeneric: We could not load the product. Try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
detail.stockEmpty: There is none of this product left.
detail.locationsEmpty: There are no stock movements for this product yet.
detail.locationsNote: This is the balance of each location's movements, and it adds up to the current stock. Consumption recorded without a location is subtracted from “No location”, so a location can show more than is really there.
detail.expiryEmpty: No batch of this product has an expiry date.
detail.expiryNote: The quantity is the one recorded when the batch was added. Consumption is not deducted from a specific batch, so less than this may be left.
detail.pricesCaption: Latest recorded prices for this product
detail.pricesEmpty: There are no recorded prices for this product yet.
detail.actionsHint: The stock forms cover the whole catalogue: you will need to pick “{name}” from the product list.
detail.deleteHint: Administrators only, and only when nothing references it. It is a real delete: no bin, no undo.
detail.deleteBlockedHistory: It cannot be deleted: it has history (stock, prices, receipts or lists), and history is kept. Leave it at zero and it stays as archived.
detail.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. If anything still references it, the delete will be refused and nothing will be lost.
detail.deleteConflict: It cannot be deleted: prices, receipt lines or list items still use it.
detail.deleteFailed: It could not be deleted. Try again.
detail.deletedBody: “{name}” is no longer in the catalogue.

scan.title: Scan barcode
scan.framingHint: Hold the barcode inside the green rectangle
scan.cameraErrorTitle: The camera could not be reached
scan.cameraErrorHint: Make sure the camera is allowed, then try again.
scan.insecureContext: The camera only works over a secure connection. Open the app through an https:// address (or localhost) and try again.
scan.torchFailed: The torch would not turn on. Another app may be using the camera — close it and try again.
scan.foundExisting: You already had “{name}” in the catalogue
scan.createdFromLookup: You created “{name}” from Open Food Facts data

rating.title: Quality
rating.additivesUnknown: No additive data, so this part is not counted as clean
rating.noData: We do not have enough information to rate this product.
rating.noDataContribute: Add its details on Open Food Facts
rating.notApplicable: Not rated: this is not a food.
rating.attribution: Data from Open Food Facts, ODbL licence

history.title: Stock history
history.intro: Every movement that explains today's number: purchases, consumptions, adjustments and transfers.
history.empty: No movements yet. The first stock you note down will show up here.
history.errorTitle: The history could not be loaded
history.errorNotFound: This product is not in your household's catalogue. It may have been deleted, or the link may point somewhere else. Go back to the list and pick it from there.
history.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet.
history.errorGeneric: We could not load it. Try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.

adjust.title: Adjust stock
adjust.intro: Correct the number when what is at home does not match what is noted. It is saved as an adjustment, with its reason.
adjust.actualHint: Count what you can see and write the total, in {unit}.
adjust.reasonHint: Why it did not match. For example: an egg broke, pantry recount.
adjust.errorTitle: The adjustment could not be saved
adjust.errorActualInvalid: Write how much is actually there: a number of zero or more.
adjust.errorReasonRequired: Write the reason for the adjustment.
adjust.errorSame: It already matches what is noted: the adjustment would change nothing.
adjust.errorNotFound: This product is not in your household's catalogue. It may have been deleted, or the link may point somewhere else. Go back to the list and pick it from there.
adjust.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet.
adjust.errorGeneric: We could not save it. Check the details and try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.

picker.noProducts: No product matches your search. Try different words, or create the product first.

add.title: Add stock
add.intro: Record what you have just brought home. Pick the product, say how much it is and, if you like, when it expires and where you put it.
add.productSelectHint: Choose the product you want to add stock to.
add.quantityHint: How much you are adding, in the unit below. For example: 2.
add.unitHint: How it is measured. For example: kg, L, pack.
add.expirationHint: Leave this blank if the product does not expire.
add.locationHint: Where you keep it, for example the fridge or the pantry.
add.notePlaceholder: For example: it was on offer
add.noteHint: To remind you of something about this entry: the brand, the offer, or who brought it.
add.errorTitle: The stock could not be added
add.errorProductRequired: Choose a product from the list.
add.errorQuantityRequired: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
add.errorUnitRequired: Enter the unit, for example kg or pack.
add.errorExpirationInvalid: That expiry date is not valid. Use the date picker.
add.errorProductNotFound: That product no longer exists. Pick another one from the list.
add.errorLocationNotFound: That location no longer exists. Choose another one, or leave it without a location.
add.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create one or ask to be invited before adding stock.
add.errorGeneric: We could not save it. Check the details and try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
add.storeHint: Where you bought it. With a store and a price, it lands in the price history.
add.priceHint: What you paid in total for this quantity.
add.errorPriceInvalid: The price has to be more than zero, or be left blank.
add.errorPriceNeedsStore: To record the price, choose the store as well.
add.advancedSummary: More details: unit, location and note

consume.title: Consume stock
consume.intro: Record what has been used up. Pick the product, see how much is left and say how much you used.
consume.availableNoProduct: Choose a product to see how much is left.
consume.availableUnknown: We could not check how much is left. You can carry on, but check the amount before you save.
consume.quantityHint: How much you used, in the unit below. It cannot be more than what is left.
consume.unitHint: How it is measured. For example: kg, L, pack.
consume.locationHint: Where you took it from, for example the fridge or the pantry.
consume.noteHint: To remind you what it went into: a recipe, a meal, or who took it.
consume.errorTitle: The consumption could not be recorded
consume.errorProductRequired: Choose a product from the list.
consume.errorQuantityRequired: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
consume.errorUnitRequired: Enter the unit, for example kg or pack.
consume.errorNotEnoughStock: There is not that much. Only {available} {unit} of this product are left. Enter that amount or less, or add stock first.
consume.errorNotEnoughStockServer: There is no longer enough of this product: someone in your household used it while you were filling in the form. Go back to the inventory to see what is left, then try a smaller amount.
consume.errorProductNotFound: That product no longer exists. Pick another one from the list.
consume.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create one or ask to be invited before consuming stock.
consume.errorGeneric: We could not save it. Check the details and try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
consume.productSelectHint: Choose the product that has been used up.
consume.advancedSummary: More details: unit, location and note

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.uploadingHint: Uploading the receipt... Hold on a moment.
receipts.uploadError: The receipt could not be uploaded. Try again.
receipts.processingFailed: The receipt could not be processed. Try uploading it again.
receipts.processed: Receipt processed! {count, plural, one {# item found} other {# items found}}.
receipts.alreadyApplied: This receipt has already been applied to the inventory
receipts.pendingItems: {count, plural, one {# item left to review} other {# items left to review}}
receipts.productNameHint: What you call it at home. It will be created in your catalogue under this name.
receipts.dropzoneLabel: Choose a photo of the receipt
receipts.dropPrompt: Drag a photo of the receipt here, or click to choose one
receipts.cameraCapture: Take a photo with the camera

applied.title: Receipt applied
applied.intro: This is what this receipt changed in your inventory.
applied.errorTitle: The summary could not be shown
applied.errorNotFound: This receipt is not in your household. The link may be old, the receipt may have been deleted, or it may belong to another household.
applied.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create one or ask to be invited before viewing receipts.
applied.errorGeneric: We could not load the summary. Try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
applied.pendingTitle: This receipt has not been applied yet
applied.pendingIntro: Nothing is added to the inventory until you apply it. Review it and apply it to finish.
applied.pendingFailed: Processing this receipt failed, so there is nothing to apply. Upload it again with a sharper photo.
applied.summaryLinesNotAppliedHint: Lines you skipped during the review, or that were never matched to a product.
applied.itemsEmpty: This receipt added no products to the inventory: every line was skipped or never matched.
applied.noteLocation: The stock was saved without a location. You can move it to a shelf or the fridge from the inventory.
applied.noteNoStore: No price was recorded because the receipt has no store attached. Prices need to know where the shopping happened.
applied.nextTitle: What would you like to do now?
applied.nextReview: See this receipt line by line

receipts.uploadStoreHint: Without a store, the receipt's prices are not recorded.
receipts.confirmedAll: You finished the review. You can apply it to the inventory now.

shopping.title: Shopping lists
shopping.autoDescription: This list was auto-generated from low stock
shopping.nothingToBuyHint: Anything that drops below its minimum turns up here, or add it yourself from your lists.
shopping.stockNone: There is none left at home
shopping.trolleyCount: {count, plural, one {# thing ticked off} other {# things ticked off}}
shopping.deleteConfirmBody: The list and everything on it will be gone. This cannot be undone.
shopping.autoListUpToDate: You checked the stock. The automatic list is up to date now.

prices.title: Prices
prices.comparisonSummary: Average {average} across {count, plural, one {# store} other {# stores}}

stores.title: Stores
stores.name: Store name
stores.deleteFailed: “{name}” could not be deleted. Prices or receipts still point at it.

hub.title: Settings
hub.intro: This is where you adjust how Stoky organises your household's things.
hub.locationsDescription: See where you keep your products: the fridge, the pantry, the storeroom and the shelves inside them. Locations are created when you add stock.
hub.storesDescription: Register the stores you shop at. They are used to record prices and to assign the receipts you scan.
hub.preferencesDescription: Choose the language of the application and whether to see it light, dark or following your device settings. The theme is saved in this browser; the language applies to the whole application.
hub.pendingTitle: There are no other settings yet
hub.pendingDescription: Household, profile and notifications cannot be configured from here yet.
hub.exportDescription: Everything this household has, in one file: products, stock, receipts, prices and lists. It is yours and you can take it whenever you like.
hub.exportFailed: The file could not be prepared. Try again in a moment.
hub.exportImagesNote: Receipt photographs are not inside the file, only where they live. To keep them, copy the server's uploads folder too.
hub.exportPrivacyNote: The archive contains the names and emails of everyone who uses this household. Keep it somewhere safe.

errors.boundaryBody: The fault is in the application, not in what you were part-way through: nothing you noted down has been lost. Try again, and if it keeps happening go to the start and come back from there.
errors.boundaryReferenceHint: That code is in the server log too, in case whoever runs the household needs to look it up.

confirmations.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete {item}? This action cannot be undone.
confirmations.unsavedChangesDescription: Do you want to save changes before leaving?

household.noHouseholdTitle: You do not have a household yet
household.noHouseholdBody: A household is where the inventory, the shopping list and the prices live. Create yours to get started; you can rename it later.
household.nameHint: Whatever you call it at home. "Home" works perfectly well.
household.createFailed: The household could not be created. Try again.
household.loadFailedTitle: The data could not be loaded
household.loadFailedBody: The request to the server failed. It may be a temporary connection problem.
household.peopleDescription: Who can get in, and what each of them can do.
household.peopleIntro: Household accounts are created here. The kitchen account is for the tablet: it can look at the inventory and record what gets used, and nothing else.
household.roleMemberHint: Can add stock, record what is used, manage the list and create products.
household.roleKitchenHint: Can only look and record what is used. Meant for a tablet in the kitchen.
household.addPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. They can change it later.
household.addDone: Account created for “{name}”. They can sign in with that address now.
household.addEmailTaken: That address already has an account. Use another.
household.addFailed: The account could not be created. Try again.
household.loadFailed: Who is in the household could not be loaded.

session.expiringIn: Your session will close in {minutes} min after being idle. Anything unsaved will be lost.
session.expired: Your session closed after being idle. Sign in again to carry on.
session.signOutClean: This will sign you out on this device. Nothing is waiting to be sent.
session.signOutPending: {count, plural, one {# change is still unsent} other {# changes are still unsent}}. Signing out now will lose them.
session.signOutShared: Sign out when you are done if other people use this device.

offline.nothingSavedBody: You are offline and this screen had not been saved on the phone. Try again once you have signal.
offline.pending: {count, plural, one {# change not sent yet} other {# changes not sent yet}}
offline.needsSignin: Sign in again to send your changes. None of them are lost.
offline.failed: {count, plural, one {# change was not saved} other {# changes were not saved}}
offline.full: No room for more offline changes. Get a signal to send the ones you have.
offline.unrepresented: Something is wrong with your unsent changes. Get a signal and open the app again.
offline.needsReconciliation: {count, plural, one {# product needs checking} other {# products need checking}}
offline.reconcileBody: You recorded using {quantity} {unit} of “{name}”, but by the time it reached the server there was less than that. Somebody else probably used it first.
offline.reconcileQuestion: How much is in the house right now?
offline.reconcileHint: Look on the shelf or in the fridge and type what you see. We will set the count to that number.
offline.reconcileFailed: That could not be adjusted. Try again.
offline.reconcileKitchen: This account can look and use things up, but not adjust the stock. Tell somebody who manages the household.
offline.unsavedDescription: What could not be saved, and what to do about it.
offline.unsavedIntro: Everything you recorded that the server did not accept. Nothing is lost: you can try again, or discard it yourself.
offline.unsavedEmptyHint: Everything you have recorded has been saved.
offline.reasonNeedsReconciliation: There was less than that left. How much is at home needs checking.
offline.reasonWrongHousehold: It was recorded in a different household.
offline.reasonRefused: The server did not accept it.
offline.reasonInvalid: Something was missing or not valid.
offline.reasonExhausted: It was tried several times and never got through.

offlinePage.title: Offline
offlinePage.heading: There is no connection right now
offlinePage.body: We could not load this screen and it was not saved on the phone. Anything you did offline is still here and will be sent on its own once you have signal again.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.nothingUrgent: Nothing is about to go off
kitchen.nothingUrgentHint: Everything in the house lasts more than three days.
kitchen.nothingThisWeek: Nothing else goes off this week
kitchen.listCreateFailed: The list cannot be created right now. Try again when the connection is back.
